title: Periodic acid-promoted methylenation of imidazoheteroarenes: a green approach using ethylene glycol as a C1 source
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11937-11943
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09947A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marcelo S. Franco, Matheus Y. G. Watanabe, Jhefferson S. Guilhermi, Brunno S. Souza, Sumbal Saba, Jamal Rafique, Antonio L. Braga
Periodic acid promotes metal-free methylenation of imidazoheteroarenes using ethylene glycol as a green C1 source. The reaction proceeds in water, delivers yields up to 97%, & is scalable, offering a sustainable approach to bis-heterocycle synthesis.
